name: ACE_ENGINE_URL
label: Playback engine address
help: Optional for AceStream. Official HTTP broadcasts do not need an engine. Saved Settings → Playback takes precedence.

name: ACE_CHECK_ENGINE_URL
label: Dedicated checking engine address
help: Leave empty for playback-engine checks. A configured checker never falls back on failure.

name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
label: Public address
help: Address players use to reach this app. Saved Integrations → Public address takes precedence.

name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_SCRAPE_TARGETS
label: Allow sources on private networks
help: Turn off when private-network sources are not needed. Metadata endpoints always remain blocked.

name: TUNER_ALLOWED_NETWORKS
label: Networks allowed to use tuner routes
help: Tuner routes do not use the API token. * allows every network.

name: CORS_ORIGINS
label: Allowed browser origins
help: Comma-separated origins, or a JSON array. Usually only needed for separate frontend hosting.

name: ENABLE_ACESTREAM_ENGINE
label: Bundled playback engine
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ACESTREAM_CHECK_ENGINE
label: Bundled checking engine
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ACEXY
label: Acexy
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_IPFS
label: IPFS
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_ZERONET
label: ZeroNet
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_TOR
label: Tor for ZeroNet
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ENABLE_WARP
label: WARP
help: Requires installed software and the corresponding Docker permissions, ports and volumes. Restart to apply.

name: ACESTREAM_BIND_ALL
label: Allow remote engine clients
help: The engine API has no authentication. Publish its port only on trusted networks.

name: WARP_ENABLE_NAT
label: Connect WARP before starting engines
help: Requires NET_ADMIN, SYS_ADMIN and /dev/net/tun in Docker. No routing changes until explicitly enabled.

name: EPG_PROGRAM_RETENTION_HOURS
label: Guide retention (hours)
help: Any negative value keeps expired programmes.
